messages:
maya (Marketing): Heads-up: aiming to publish Hyperwave launch post Tue 10:00am PT. Need final changelog, a stable docs URL, and a short benchmark blurb by EOD tomorrow so we can wire webinar promo.
aj (Engineering): Working on changelog now (PR #8420). I'll include canary notes, rollback commands, and the exact config snippet Sam wants.
sam (Docs): I can publish a stable /docs/hyperwave-release page once AJ's PR lands. Please put example config in the changelog PR so I can copy it.
lina (Product): Webinar slot locked Thu 11am PT. Marketing will send a teaser Wed AM; want a 1-paragraph bench summary + 3 bullet highlights for slides and landing.
aj (Engineering): Bench summary (draft): "Hyperwave reduces median latency by ~28% on 8k context workloads and cuts per-token inference cost by ~30% through smarter batching and quant-aware kernels. It also adds an optional prefix-caching mode for hot sessions to improve p95 latency."
aj (Engineering): Bullets: (1) ~28% median latency improvement (8k), (2) ~30% per-token cost reduction with batching+quant, (3) optional prefix-caching for steady sub-50ms p95 token times on hot sessions.
maya (Marketing): Great — that's exactly what we need. Sam, once you have /docs/hyperwave-release live, drop the canonical link here and we'll put it in the post + webinar CTAs.
sam (Docs): Will merge and publish in the morning; I'll post the canonical URL here when done.
deploy-bot: Docs deploy scheduled: hyperwave -> staging at 2026-03-25T03:00:00Z.
maya (Marketing): Also, small ask: can Engineering attach the short migration snippet for Dedicated customers (reserved capacity) so we can add a callout box? Keeps support triage down.
aj (Engineering): Yep, will add a Dedicated migration example and a note about Dedicated vs Hosted behavior.
lina (Product): We'll coordinate the webinar slide deck with those bullets + the migration callout. Maya, send me the deck draft Tue night and I'll review.
maya (Marketing): Will do. Locking post draft tonight and will ping for final links before publish. :rocket:
